description: This file defines a PHP class 'templateParser' responsible for parsing templates with data from beans in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to replace placeholders in templates with bean data, handle related beans, format various data types, and generate HTML snippets like images.

classes.name: templateParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and replacing placeholders in templates based on Bean data, including handling of related beans and various data types.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Main method that iterates over an array of beans and applies parsing for each bean and related beans, replacing placeholders in the provided template string.

methods.name: parse_template_bean
methods.description: Performs placeholder replacement within a template string for a specific bean, handling different field types, related data, and special formatting rules.
